**SQL used**

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x37527.x1_retention AS
WITH signups AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', signup_date) AS cohort_week,
         signup_date
  FROM workspace.exam_x37527.signups
),
activity AS (
  SELECT a.user_id,
         a.activity_date,
         FLOOR(DATEDIFF(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7) AS week_n,
         s.cohort_week
  FROM workspace.exam_x37527.activity a
  JOIN signups s ON a.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE a.activity_date >= s.signup_date
    AND FLOOR(DATEDIFF(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7) BETWEEN 0 AND 4
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT cohort_week, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM signups
  GROUP BY cohort_week
),
active AS (
  SELECT cohort_week,
         week_n,
         COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
  FROM activity
  GROUP BY cohort_week, week_n
)
SELECT cs.cohort_week,
       cs.cohort_size,
       n.week_n,
       COALESCE(a.active_users,0) AS active_users,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(a.active_users,0) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS retention_pct
FROM cohort_sizes cs
CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS week_n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) n
LEFT JOIN active a
  ON cs.cohort_week = a.cohort_week AND n.week_n = a.week_n
ORDER BY cs.cohort_week, n.week_n;
```
